_comment: Part-family recognition catalog. Each entry has three optional axes: lib_id_substrings (case-insensitive substring match against component lib_id), value_patterns (regex strings compiled with re.I and matched against the Value field), and reference_prefixes (refdes letter codes — informational only; not authoritative on their own since 'D' would match every diode). Extracted from rules.py module-level constants on 2026-05-18.

relay._desc: Relays / coil-bearing parts. Drives PROT_004 (freewheel diode required).

usb_connector._desc: USB host/device/OTG connectors. Drives USB_001/002 (series R, TVS, decoupling).

debug_header._desc: SWD / JTAG / Cortex debug connectors. Drives DBG_001/002 (SRST + VTREF tie).

polarized_cap._desc: Electrolytic / tantalum / polarized caps. Drives orientation + value-format checks.

tvs._desc: TVS / ESD protection diodes (USBLC6, PESD, TPD, RClamp, etc.). Drives ESD_001/002 and USB protection rules.

uart_bridge._desc: USB-UART bridge ICs (CH340, CP2102, FT23x, etc.). Drives bridge-specific power + series-R checks.

isolation._desc: Ferrite beads / isolation inductors used to split AVDD from VDD. Drives POWER_006 isolation detection.
